content: परित्यज् €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To leave, quit, abandon. .²2 To resign, give up, discard, renounce; प्रारब्धमुत्तमगुणा न परित्यजन्ति <ls>Mu. 2. 17</ls>. .²3 To except; तृणमप्यपरित्यज्य सतृणम् <ls>Sk.</ls> .²4 To leave over, leave as a remainder. .²5 To neglect, disregard. .²6 To forsake (the body), die. .²7 To disembark (with नावम्). --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To deprive a person of, rob any one of.
